title: Mission to recover Panasonic Toughbooks with crash-retrieval evidence
place_text: returned to a facility in the California desert

tellings.quote: This was happening at a time we were set out to recover some sensitive information that was believed to be kept on some tough books.

plain: A man named Jake Barber, who says on the show that he flew helicopters on missions to recover a UFO, tells Michels he took part in a mission to get back "sensitive information" believed to be stored on Panasonic Toughbooks, which are rugged laptops. He says the information was evidence from crash retrievals, meaning the recovery of crashed craft of unknown origin, and that it went back to a facility in the California desert. If true, it would mean records of such recoveries exist and were moved around in secret.
